prose.subject: New Payout Account Update and Invoice INV-86988
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you of a recent update to our payment processing details at Larchmont Facilities.

To streamline our disbursements, we have added a new payout account: 0x9e76a3bdf059a7302e15775c685e5af4c2d82599. This address has been officially linked to our verified domain, larchmont-facilities.example, ensuring that all future transfers are securely recognized by your systems.

Please ensure that subsequent payments are directed to this new address. For clarity, I have attached invoice INV-86988, which totals 983.57 USDC, for your records and processing. This invoice covers the services rendered during the previous billing cycle.

If you have any questions regarding the transition or need further verification of the new account details, please do not hesitate to reach out. We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
Ines Okafor
Larchmont Facilities
